description: Tokens & NFTs owned by a Solana wallet — lists every digital asset (fungible tokens, regular + compressed NFTs) held by an address via the Digital Asset Standard (DAS), with name, symbol, balance, and interface type. Example: helius_assets_by_owner({ address: "86xCnPeV69n6t3DnyGvkKobf9FdN2H9oiVDdaMpo2MMY", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Helius API key (free 1M credits/mo at helius.dev)

address.description: Solana wallet address (base58) whose assets to list

name: helius_assets_by_owner
title: Helius Assets By Owner
